mapper.insert: INSERT INTO novel_pipeline_checkpoint (novel_id, session_id, current_stage, pipeline_execution_state, last_failure_message, update_time) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{sessionId}, #{currentStage}, #{pipelineExecutionState}, #{lastFailureMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (novel_id) DO UPDATE SET session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id, current_stage = EXCLUDED.current_stage, pipeline_execution_state = EXCLUDED.pipeline_execution_state, last_failure_message = EXCLUDED.last_failure_message, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, novel_id, session_id, current_stage, pipeline_execution_state, last_failure_message, update_time FROM novel_pipeline_checkpoint WHERE novel_id = #{novelId}
